I dont see `vm.div.i32.u` anywhere in the output
The PR mentioned in the issue is now changed. To repro this issue now use this PR : https://github.com/google/iree/pull/2066 . The gemm.mlir shows the commands to run
For the warnings in the original issue, update your Vulkan SDK / validation layers. Those errors are likely false positives.
Yeah, we literally only ever set the signal value to a constant 1, so it's likely a red herring. Figuring out why something is dividing by zero is probably more useful.
I get this error on swift shader (not running with my local vulkan drivers)

SwiftShader is just a Vulkan ICD. The validation layers are separate - you should be able to update them by installing a recent version of the Vulkan SDK, updating your system's GPU drivers, or downloading the layers directly.

We have IREE-focused docs that discuss the different components and link to other references here: https://google.github.io/iree/GetStarted/GenericVulkanSetup

I gave it a try [on my side](https://github.com/antiagainst/iree/tree/check-workgroup-failure) by rebasing #2066 against master and changes `i32` to `f32`. I wasn't able to reproduce the issue: workgroup memory is properly used in the IR and the generated result is correct. It might be fixed by recent changes. So closing this; feel free to reopen if Mahesh you still see the issue.
